bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
user="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' "$name")" || exit 61
test "$user" = 0:0 || exit 80
src="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
test -n "$src" && test -f "$src" && test ! -L "$src" || exit 81
test "$(stat -c '%a' "$src")" = 600 || exit 82
if docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint /bin/sh --user 0:0 --mount "type=bind,source=$src,target=/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token,readonly" create-videobot:local-poll -c 'test -r /run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token' >/dev/null 2>&1;then
 exit 0
fi
exit 83
